name: social tension
description: People are perceived as possibly having negative judgements of you or other people.

variations.name: dangerous tension
variations.description: If you predict the tension may become a harmful conflict, it may escalate to fear.

commentaries.quote: Sometimes laughing can be a signal to suggest defusing perceived tension. Comedy like 'Seinfeld' is based heavily on cringy social tension.

conditions: Agents are perceived as being in minor conflict.
